info.title: Rochell Core API
info.description: Vertical Slice #1 (Frozen Baseline v2.1.1). Decimal values are JSON strings (ADR-015).

get.summary: The signed-in user, session expiry, step-up freshness and roles per company.
E-PAR-3: the deployment's label for the top bar (null: the web decides from the host name) and, E-MAIL-01-4, whether it sends mail (OFF, REDIRECT, LIVE). No sign-in needed.

post.summary: E-VS4-02-5: Alanube's notice that an e-CF finished; it only moves forward the status query. Needs the secret header.

get.summary: Starts the Google Workspace sign-in (browser navigation).
Re-authenticates the current user (prompt=login) before an action that requires it.
Synthetic users the signed-in person may act as in a company (needs identity:act_as; TEST databases only).

post.summary: Acts as a synthetic user (E-B03-14): segregation of duties and four-eyes rules apply to it as to anyone.
Returns to the signed-in person's own session.

get.summary: E-ENT-1: what the driver's page shows of a delivery (no prices) and the link's state. No sign-in; the link's HMAC is the key.

post.summary: E-ENT-2: checks the driver's PIN before the photo. Every try is kept; 5 wrong lock the link.
E-ENT-3/4: the driver's confirmation (multipart, with the photo or signature). FULL records the POD; DIFFERENCES waits for Dispatch.
